cards.purpose: UNESCO-custom Y-variant of SAP-standard FM line-item report RFFMEPGAX (the FMRP_RFFMEP*X "All/FI/CO Postings" family), called by the UBO portal integration to pull Funds Management actual/commitment line items.
cards.insight: Integration dependency + automation/load concern: 100% of 30,738 executions come from one non-human actor, UBO-RFC (the UNESCO Budget Online portal channel). This is the read counterpart to UBO-RFC's FI write channel (Y_RFC_FMRP_RFFMEP1FX_FI_POST, ~30K) already flagged in the H71 SoD remediation. It is NOT a manual-automation candidate (already fully machine-driven) and NOT key-person risk (no humans). The real signal: UBO is a critical, high-volume integration dependency feeding FM data to an external portal via a custom report fork of standard RFFMEPGAX — single point of failure for budget-reporting in the portal, and the same identity that carries the write-channel SoD exposure. The custom Y-fork also duplicates SAP-standard RFFMEPGAX (which 441 humans run directly, 9,650x), so it is a maintenance/S4-migration liability that should be justified or retired in favor of the standard report / a released CDS-based interface.
cards.owner_hint: UBO portal team (integration); FM/PSM functional owners. UBO-RFC service account = UNESCO Budget Online channel, same identity as the H71 write-channel actor.
cards.evidence: Custom: name starts with Y_ (UNESCO custom namespace). Standard base RFFMEPGAX confirmed via Gold DB d01_tstc: tcodes FMRP_RFFMEP1AX/1CX/1FX map PGMNA=RFFMEPGAX; d01_tstct labels FMRP_RFFMEP1AX='All Postings', 1FX='FI Postings', 1CX='CO Postings' (PSM/FM reporting). cards.purpose: Standard SAP transaction to DISPLAY a Funds Reservation (earmarked-funds document) in PSM Funds Management — read-only sibling of FMX1 create / FMX2 change / FMX4 approve.
cards.insight: Read-only display tcode with extreme volume (16,939 events / 4mo, heavily-used) spread over 406 distinct human actors with a long tail (top user V_BONNET only 669 = ~4%) — this is broad lookup activity, NOT automation candidate (display has nothing to automate), NOT a write-channel/SoD concern (display-only, no posting), and NOT key-person risk (well-distributed). The real signal: FMX3 is the most-consulted FM document-display point in the org, so the budget/funds-reservation data model behind SAPLFMFR (FMRESERV earmarked-funds docs) is hot read-path — a candidate to surface via a self-service Fiori/report layer to offload GUI lookups. Note: brain syslog analysis flags one user 'heavy on FMX3' (E0A 1,181 msgs) classified as benign operational noise, consistent with high read traffic, not an error.

cards.insight: Integration-criticality + custom-extension dependency: FMX2 is a heavily-used (13,580 in ~4mo) manual fund-reservation maintenance txn that is the hook point for THREE UNESCO custom enhancements — ZFIX_EF_FUND_RESERVATION + ZFIX_EXCHANGERATE_FUNDBLOCK apply the budget-rate (1.09529) conversion writing FR positions to FMIOI, and ZXFMCU17 enforces the 2%/$2000 AVC tolerance cap. cards.purpose: Custom RFC-enabled BAPI-style FM that creates an FM Budgeting Entry document (FMBB/FMKU0050-style budget posting) with implicit commit; UNESCO's write channel for pushing fund/budget master into SAP FM.
cards.insight: Integration dependency + write-channel: this is a MULESOFT-only inbound write (100% of 4,953 calls from MULESOFT, 1 actor) that posts FM budgeting/fund-entry documents as part of the PPM(Salesforce)->SAP project+fund master sync. PPM is the master; SAP receives funds/budget IN via this FM. Single-channel criticality — if the MuleSoft flow breaks, fund/budget master creation in SAP stops; and since it commits FM budget postings under the integration's service ID (not a named user), the control must live at the call/data layer, not the role layer (consistent with the H71 write-channel SoD pattern). Not a dead-code or automation candidate; it IS the automation.

### TOP 5 actionable insights

1. **Two unmonitored MuleSoft + UBO write channels carry the H71 SoD exposure — control must move to the call/data layer.** `Y_FMKU_0050_CREATE_WITH_COMMIT` (4,953), `Y_BAPI_FUND_C5_ASSIGNMENT` (3,309) and the UBO read-side `Y_RFFMEPGAX_FOR_UBO_1` (30,738) are each **100% single-service-account** (MULESOFT / UBO-RFC), zero humans, no role-layer 4-eyes. These are the AS-RUN backbone of PPM(Salesforce)→SAP fund/budget master sync and the portal read feed. Single points of failure with no segregation; remediation belongs at the BAdI/call layer, not the role layer.

2. **The org's two most-used custom budget monitors are blind to the exact defect they should catch.** `YPS8` (11,314 / 571 users) and `YFM1` (10,134 / 557 users) reuse the same `IS_COMMITMENT_ITEM_IN_AVC` filter as the FM-AVC engine — so they cannot pre-empt INC-000005638-class donor-fund FIPEX-deficit overruns. Combined ~21K runs across the org make this a **high blast-radius monitoring blind spot**. Fix: a per-FIPEX `committed_vs_available_detector`, not more YPS8/YFM1 runs.

3. **ICTP is a single-entity custom monolith and a bus-factor risk.** `ZICTP_COCKPIT` (5,014) fronts a 70+ object ZICTP_* suite re-implementing standard SAP (ME28/ME2L/MIRO/FBL1N/cash/VAT) for one Cat-1 institute — with **42% of volume on just 2 Trieste-local users (D_CRESEVICH, B_RAZZINI)**. Largest single decommission burden for S/4 and the clearest key-person concentration in the set. Lever: consolidate ICTP onto standard tcodes.

4. **Custom forks duplicate SAP-standard reports that hundreds of humans already run directly — maintenance/S4 liability.** `RFFMEPGAX` (std, 9,650 / 441 users) is forked into `ZRFFMEPGAX_NEW` (tcode ZICTP_REP_BCS) **and** `Y_RFFMEPGAX_FOR_UBO_1` (30,738). Plus `RFFMRE01` (11,115 / 323) and `FMRP_RFFMEP1FX` (3,319 / 196) are heavily-used standard list reports — exactly the RFFMR*/RFFMEP* family superseded by FM Fiori/embedded analytics. Justify-or-retire the forks; map the standards to S/4 apps.

5. **High-volume manual reporting pulls are schedulable, not just "more usage."** `YPS3` (3,509, FIT-donor financial statements, G_DARD 418/33% top-5 concentration) is a recurring manual donor-statement run granted via display-only roles — a clean automation/scheduling candidate. Secondary cleanup: the `YFM1*` sibling sprawl (15+ variants: _NEW/_OLD/_USD/_ICTP/_V4/YFM11) is fragmentation debt.

*Explicitly NOT flagged:* FMX3/FM5S/FMRP_RFFMEP1FX as automation (display/read = nothing to automate); none of the heavily-distributed reports (RFFMEPGAX, RFFMRE01, FM5S, all top users ≤8%) as key-person risk.

---

### What AS-RUN tells us vs the static catalog

The static catalog says UNESCO runs FM on **standard SAP** — FMX1/2/3, FM5S, RFFMEPGAX, RFFMRE01, the FMRP_RFFMEP1* family. The usage picture says something sharper: **the standard transactions are the human read/maintain surface (FMX3 16.9K, FMX2 13.6K, RFFMRE01 11.1K, all broadly spread across 200–440 named users), but every load-bearing decision path has been custom-wrapped.** Budget monitoring actually runs on custom Y-reports (YPS8/YFM1/YPS_BA/YPS3 ≈ 29K combined), all hand-bridging FM↔PS WBS and all AVC-blind; master/budget data actually enters SAP through MuleSoft and UBO RFC write channels (≈8.3K silent service-account writes) that the catalog shows as ordinary FMs; and one institute (ICTP) runs a parallel 70+ object copy of the standard stack. The standard tcodes carry the clicks; the custom layer carries the truth — and that custom layer is simultaneously where the AVC monitoring blind spot, the SoD write-channel exposure, the key-person concentration, and the entire S/4 re-platform burden live.
